name: wakeshift-openclaw
description: Wakeshift for OpenClaw: wakes an OpenClaw session when an app it watches through Wakeshift sends something.

scripts.pack: npm run build && node scripts/stamp-version.mjs && npm pack --pack-destination ${PACK_DIR:-.} && mv ${PACK_DIR:-.}/wakeshift-openclaw-$npm_package_version.tgz ${PACK_DIR:-.}/wakeshift-openclaw.tgz
